## Research gaps

59 todo platforms have fewer than 2 verified example boards: ADP, ApplicantPro, Artha, Avature, BrassRing, CSOD, CareerPlug, CareerSiteCloud, Comeet, Dayforce, Deel, Dover, Eightfold AI, FirstStage, Freshteam, GoHire, HiBob, HireBridge, HireHive, Hireology, HiringThing, JBoard.io, JOIN.com, JazzHR, JobBoard.com, JobBoard.io, JobBoardFire, JobKit, JobMount, Jobboardly, Jobiqo, Kula.ai, Niceboard, Nodex, PageUp, Paradox, Paycom, Paycor, Paylocity, Phenom People, Polymer, Recooty, Rival, SAP SuccessFactors, SmartJobBoard, Talenetic, Taleo, TriNet, UltiPro, WP Job Manager, WeRecruit, Zoho Recruit, eJobBoard, ejobsitesoftware.com, iCIMS, iSolvedHire, jobBoardHQ, jobboardsoftware.com, talentReef.

"Verified" means the endpoint and examples answered a live request on that date; "no" means the entry comes from documentation or prior knowledge and must be re-checked before implementation. "Generic" = whether the generic sitemap/RSS + schema.org JobPosting approach worked on the evaluated boards (`scripts/evaluate_generic.py`).
